title: Automated exergoeconomic screening of a cascade high-temperature heat pump for industrial steam generation
description: Source code and result data for the exergy and exergoeconomic analysis of cascaded two-stage high-temperature heat pumps for industrial steam generation, built on the open-source TESPy and ExerPy frameworks. Running the pipeline reproduces the figures and tables of the accompanying journal article.
